*Results based on third-party instrumental corneometer test of 32 subjects compared to untreated skin post-application and at time points throughout a 12-hour duration of the study.

*** Skin barrier function was measured by assessing the reduction in transepidermal water loss compared to an untreated control in a clinical study of 32 subjects.

patented technology, trending ingredients

2X FermentVital Complex™

A potent blend of Korean inspired ingredients with a two-step fermentation process to help moisturize, brighten and clarify skin.

Learn More

fermented rice

Helps bolster a stronger moisture barrier. Brightens, softens and tones skin providing a natural lit-within glow.

fermented ginseng

Helps improve the appearance of skin‘s elasticity and minimizes the look of fine lines for a more youthful appearance.

fermented adlay

Helps improve the appearance of skin hydration and elasticity, enhances skin’s natural moisture and helps the skin look firm, hydrated and supple.

fermented potato

Helps comfort and nurture the skin to enhance the skin‘s natural radiance for a healthy, glowing complexion.
